source_evidence.qualification_scope: Five source-qualified CVPR2026 main papers; source qualification is not runtime/capacity/legal redistribution approval.

paper.title: UCAN: Unified Convolutional Attention Network for Expansive Receptive Fields in Lightweight Super-Resolution

repository.official_link_evidence: Primary CVF/complete PDF and author repository qualification recorded in candidate_backbones.json; reused fixed source evidence, not a new author inertial implementation.

source_recheck.method: Each actual core raw file SHA/byte count verified and AST parsed, no upstream module imported. Fixed root LICENSE raw bytes fetched/hash matched and saved unmodified using apply_patch. Prior complete primary PDF qualification reused from source evidence; no datasets/weights fetched.

adaptation.selected_core: Compact same-forward local attention map plus raw-Q/K sharing/receiving, Hedgehog global/channel dual fusion and selective first16-channel LKSA; NOT the complete UCAN SR architecture.
adaptation.draft_recipe_status: Explicit compact width/depth/patch/operator/initialization hypotheses; not original full visual-model profile, measured capacity, accuracy, latency or final-initialization parity.
adaptation.initialization: Hedgehog eye/zero bias intentionally retained despite source full-model trunc-normal override; Fourier coefficients source-style Xavier normal gain0.5+structured offsets; LayerScale1e-4; other temporal layer defaults. Initialization parity is explicitly not claimed.
adaptation.readout: Final LayerNorm, temporal mean of patch tokens, one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head.
keep: Sender local-window QKV attention, learned relative-time bias and receiver's own V/projection using the sender map
Same-forward unmodified raw Q/K shared to receiving dual-fusion; each group keeps its own V, Hedgehog maps, Fourier position module and projection
Hedgehog feature map concat(2*Linear(x),-2*Linear(x)).softmax, positive/negative symmetric features
Global linear fusion: non-positioned mean-key normalizer+1e-6, Fourier-positioned Q/K, length^-0.5 K/V factors and local depthwise V contribution
Channel fusion from time-normalized raw Q/K, learned per-channel temperature, softmax and V readout
Source-style receiving/sharing residual placement, spatial-gate FFNs and LayerScale1e-4
Selective first sixteen channels for large-kernel spatial refinement (remaining channels pass through), residual merge
replace: 2D windows/relative bias ->1D temporal windows with explicit zero padding and invalid-key masks; original six sensor axes remain channels
2D SGFN/depthwise local V/LKSA convolutions -> explicit 1D temporal counterparts
Source k23 2D factorization -> temporal k5 followed by k5 dilation2, effective RF13; not a23-tap temporal kernel
External/spatial Fourier coordinates -> internal temporal token positions; frequency tensor registered as device-following buffer instead of released automatic-CUDA/unregistered tensor
Signed Fourier coefficient-sum denominator -> signed epsilon safeguard abs(sum).clamp_min(1e-6), preserving sign and minus rotation; source one-padding retained
Source full depth4 groups -> one sender/receiver pair, each with one selective LKSA in compact draft
RGB normalization/SR stem/reconstruction -> ordered Conv1d6->32,p4,stride4, GAP and one XYZ velocity head/plainMSE
omitted: HPA/large-attention branches, MBConv/ESA wrappers and extra full architecture stages
RGB means, upsampler/PixelShuffle/SR reconstruction and image acquisition wrappers
L1/LDL/wavelet and other original SR losses
FlashAttention/native spatial kernel speed paths or paper quality/latency claims
Any cross-forward or cross-window cache carry
paper_code_adapter_differences: Sharing maps/rawQK is NOT all-layer weight tying: receiving modules have independent V/FOPE/Hedgehog/proj weights.

Current port intentionally keeps Hedgehog module's identity Linear initialization. Source top-level self.apply(_init_weights) overwrites that eye with Linear truncated-normal std0.02; identity-featuremap initialization is an explicit adapter hypothesis, not source final-init parity.
Fourier signed-epsilon guard changes near-zero-sum behavior and CPU-safe buffer/device semantics; this must stay part of implementation identity.
Fourier source minus rotation and missing-frequency one-padding retained; these features are positional mixing, not FFT denoising of IMU.
One pair/compact D32/p4/window10 draft and removal of HPA/MBConv/SR wrappers make this a source-qualified COMPONENT architecture port, not full UCAN reproduction.
Temporal RF13 follows explicit collapsed factors, not original2D k23 geometry or an unmeasured expansive-receptive-field claim.
adaptation.large_kernel_scope: source k23 factors collapsed to temporal5 then5/dilation2, effective RF13; first16 latent channels only
adaptation.objective: Shared plain supervised MSE over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity only; set_loss rejects non-MSE or kwargs. No source-task/SSL/teacher losses mixed into this identity.
adaptation.input_permissions: Same admitted reference_oracle six-axis task view as controls; no image/text/skeleton/geography/initial velocity/extra sensor/targets in forward/per-test fitting.
adaptation.temporal_scope: window_noncausal; only admitted T200 samples, no outside-window context or persistent fast weights/hidden state/maps.
risks: Compact source-qualified core is not full UCAN/HPA/MBConv/SR replication.
Map/QK caches must be function-local and never persist across windows; sharing is not parameter tying.
Padding/Fourier normalization and large-kernel smoothing may alter temporal behavior and need independent value/gradient tests.
No SR quality, FlashAttention speed or physics/IMU denoising claim.

scientific_contract.output: vel:B,3 real supervised XYZ average velocity in m/s; no zero-padded Z
scientific_contract.xy_semantics: XY is the slice of the same XYZ prediction, no second XY model/head
scientific_contract.task_head: Final LayerNorm, temporal mean of patch tokens, one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head.
scientific_contract.optional_ssl_or_auxiliary_recipe: Not selected; any future source-specific loss requires separately named preregistered identity and budget.
